title: The code passes clippy on Rust 1.99 without allow attributes
outcome: The code passes clippy on Rust 1.99 without allow attributes
acceptance: The full gate passes on Windows, on Rust 1.99.0

cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings passes with Rust 1.99.0, fixing the lints it reports (needless_borrows_for_generic_args and the assert-is-empty lints, mostly in tests) without allow attributes or loosened tests

completion.summary:
The code passes clippy -D warnings on Rust 1.99 (Windows and WSL) with no allow attributes and no loosened tests. Fixes:
- 132 assert-is-empty sites, each now printing the checked value, which is bound once where computed.
- 5 needless borrows of generic arguments.
The full gate passed 9/9 on Windows 1.99.0; round 2 of review is clean; the evaluation passed. Landed as 92383f5 and installed as build 834f7494.
